imagePrompt:
For the line "Mama, when did that happen?": Keep this photo exactly as it is — the church, its steps, the black handrail, the hedges, the camera, the light — and move the two women up to the doors. Image 1 is this frame of the church steps. Image 2 is the mother. Image 3 is her daughter.
Medium shot from the sidewalk, the lens at hip height up the flight, sharp on both faces. The same woman as Image 2 on the top landing in front of the closed white doors, turned back to face down the steps, her body three-quarter to the lens, a hand on her hip, eyes on her daughter, a small smile; emerald-green church dress to mid-calf, low black pumps, a wide-brim black Sunday hat. The same woman as Image 3 on the top step just below her, right hand on the top of the black handrail, face up to her mother, both eyes on her, mouth open mid-word; olive-green crewneck sweatshirt, black denim shorts, white trainers. 
In the frame: the two women, the one flight of Image 1, the handrail, the hedges, the doors; every other surface bare. Two legs each.
The render and light of Image 1 — Sunday afternoon sun, a catchlight in each eye. Clothing plain — no lettering, logos or labels; no third person.
